question: Regarding the Ring Road — West Bengal Pkg-128 assignment under PMP, with Amit Iyer as the assigned contact, could you please confirm the collection figure out of 100 for all amounts billed to the client?

WHERE i.invoice_date IS NOT NULL AND i.invoice_date <> ''
WITH w, i, c
ORDER BY i.invoice_date
WITH w, collect(i) AS invoices

  SUM([inv IN invoices WHERE inv.invoiced IS NOT NULL | toFloat(inv.invoiced)]) AS total_invoiced,
  SUM([inv IN invoices WHERE inv.received IS NOT NULL | toFloat(inv.received)]) AS total_received,

  END AS collection_percentage
